lead: Droupadi Murmu is best known as an Indian politician, born on 20 June 1958 in Mayurbhanj district.
As of 2026, she is 68 years old, and her birth date places her under the Gemini sign.

She has held the office of Member of the Thirteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly and Member of the Twelfth Odisha Legislative Assembly and has been recognised with honorary doctor of the Constantine the Philosopher University in Nitra and honorary companion of the Order of Fiji.
This profile collects the Droupadi facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Droupadi Murmu — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Droupadi Murmu was born on 20 June 1958 in Mayurbhanj district, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name Durgi Biranchi Tudu at birth and is publicly known as Droupadi Murmu.
Public records name her father, Biranchi Narayan Tudu.
She received her education at Rama Devi Women's University.
She is recorded as speaking Odia, Santali, English and Hindi.

sections.heading: Droupadi Murmu — Career and Professional Work
paras: Droupadi Murmu works primarily as a politician and school teacher.

She has held the following offices: Member of the Thirteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2004–2009), Member of the Twelfth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2000–2004), Governor of Jharkhand (2015–2021) and President of India (2022–present). She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
